verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
BULLIJO tutendereza
Ekibuga kyaffe,
Ekyakubibwa mu ggulu,
Yesu kye yazimba.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
Nandibuuse,nandituuse
Eri mu Sayuuni

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Era-ennyumba zaakyo zonna
Ziringa nga zaabu;
Ze zisinga zonna ddala
Ezizimbibwa abantu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
Nandibuuse,nandituuse
Eri mu Sayuuni

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Yesu mwali,ye Mukama,
Abafuga bonna;
Bamalayika beeyanza,
Nga bamuweereza.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
Nandibuuse,nandituuse
Eri mu Sayuuni

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
4
Mu ntebe ye mufuluma
-Amazzi g'obulamu
Agamasamasa ddala
Nga-effeeza-ennungi.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
Nandibuuse,nandituuse
Eri mu Sayuuni

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
5
Era gy'ali gye gumera
-Omuti gw'Obulamu
Amalagala kwe gali
Agawonya-abantu

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
Nandibuuse,nandituuse
Eri mu Sayuuni

verse.name: v11
verse.lines:
6
Ffe tusiime ekibuga
Yesu Kristo waffe
Kye yatulongoosereza
Ekiri mu ggulu.

verse.name: v12
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
Nandibuuse,nandituuse
Eri mu Sayuuni

verse.name: v13
verse.lines:
7
Otuzibule amaaso,
Yesu tukulabe;
Tubiwulire-ebigambo
Bya Mukama waffe.

verse.name: v14
verse.lines:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa
Nga bamalayika,
